articles.summary: We're excited to welcome Oscar Lanzendorf from ElevenLabs as our next guest on Inside The Pipeline. If you haven't heard of ElevenLabs, here's what you need to know: they've grown from zero to $300M ARR in just three years, now valued at $6.6BN with a team of 400. They've become the dominant force in the voice AI space.
articles.title: Inside The Pipeline with Oscar Lanzendorf from ElevenLabs

articles.summary: We've added human cold calling to Throxy. Here's why and what we're seeing. In October, our internal growth team increased their volume of cold calls to Throxy prospects: software companies selling into manufacturing, logistics, and healthcare. It booked meetings, but more importantly, it gave us raw market feedback on what resonated, what didn't, and which parts of our offering prospects already had covered.
articles.title: Announcing the launch of throxy 2.0
